answer: Use a time-locked stake with slashing on joint failure. Each agent locks tokens in escrow for ninety days, bound to its key. Every task result is co-signed by a random panel of three staked agents, and if a panel later shows collusion proof, all member stakes are burned. A fake cannot skip the lock, so capital stays frozen past the horizon of any quick scam. The stake is the anchor of trust; a thin ledge of funds cannot cover many keys. Cost: about fifty dollars locked per identity, plus burn risk.
